true:false.text: Turns off configurable response scanning. Built-in core patterns still apply.

false:true.text: Turns configurable response scanning back on under the configured action.

block:warn.text: Changes the response action from blocking to logging a warning.

warn:block.text: Changes the response action from logging a warning to blocking.

added.text: Exempts responses from {value} from injection scanning. On the forward proxy and intercepted TLS, the exemption can also skip the normal scan-size limit, metadata stripping, and Browser Shield rewriting for complete non-SVG responses. Outbound secret scanning still applies.

removed.text: Removes the response-injection scanning exemption for {value}.
